SURF_P.reference_observability: R64-vs-R128 extrema timing error is zero for all four cases; B02/B05 timing defects are therefore candidate-specific in this P3 panel.
interpretation: S4 conserves total storage extremely closely in the tested formulation but redistributes water vertically with material-dependent error.
S4 daily timing fidelity is not robust across materials: B02 and validation material B05 have large, reference-observable extrema timing errors.
B11 and validation material B16 retain useful approximate daily profile behaviour without discrete timing error.

B02.failure: iterative Heun corrector did not converge

B05.failure: iterative Heun corrector did not converge

interpretation: Where G8 remains numerically qualified (B11, B16), daily sign and reversal semantics are reproduced with zero discrete mismatch under the fresh 60-day forcing.
The frozen dt=0.01 day Heun implementation fails closed for development B02 and validation B05, so practical groundwater robustness is not established.
The B05 long-horizon failure is numerical blocking, distinct from the short-horizon representation/reversal limitation previously characterized in P2D.

conclusion: The current Python/Heun practical implementation is slower than the tested R128 Reference Richards implementation for every qualified 60-day P3 case.
Earlier P2A/P2B speed ratios against R256 remain valid for those short-horizon same-runner tests, but they do not establish a general practical speed advantage.
A computationally attractive reduced state dimension alone is insufficient; implementation and time-integration cost dominate this P3 workload.

P-ROM-SM.reason: Numerically stable in P3 but daily timing is material-dependent and current implementation is slower than R128.

P-ROM-GW.reason: Excellent daily event semantics in qualified B11/B16 cases, but numerical blocking in B02/B05 and current implementation slower than R128.

scientific_conclusions: Purpose-specific placement remains scientifically supported; P3 does not restore a universal representation claim.
Longer-horizon practical validation exposes failure modes that were not visible in the short-horizon benchmark: S4 timing sensitivity and G8 integrator robustness.
Practical usefulness cannot be claimed from state-count reduction alone.
The next blocker is numerical implementation/integration, not a justified reason to add more states or tune closure.
